positive_sequences.name: five_distinct_accounts_one_source
positive_sequences.scenario: Five distinct accounts fail from a single documentation address.
positive_sequences.rationale: The distinct account count reaches the configured threshold within the window.

positive_sequences.name: six_distinct_accounts_one_source
positive_sequences.scenario: Six distinct accounts fail from a single documentation address.
positive_sequences.rationale: The distinct account count exceeds the configured threshold within the window.

negative_sequences.name: repeated_failures_single_account
negative_sequences.scenario: Six failures against a single account from one address.
negative_sequences.rationale: The distinct account count stays at one, below the threshold.

negative_sequences.name: distinct_accounts_split_across_sources
negative_sequences.scenario: Six distinct accounts fail, split evenly across two addresses.
negative_sequences.rationale: No single source address reaches the distinct account threshold.

negative_sequences.name: four_distinct_accounts_below_threshold
negative_sequences.scenario: Four distinct accounts fail from one address.
negative_sequences.rationale: The distinct account count remains below the threshold.

notes: All sequences are synthetic and deterministic. Negative sequences break exactly one correlation requirement each: ordering, grouping, threshold, or timespan.
